title: Second review output
description: What Codex returns for `triage second-review`: one verdict per requested finding, exactly once. validateSecondReview() in pipeline/lib/triage.mjs enforces it (every requested id exactly once, nothing else).

id.description: The finding id exactly as given in the packet.

decision.description: ACCEPT: the finding is real, fix it in this PR. FOLLOW-UP: real but out of scope for this PR. REJECT: not a real problem or not worth doing.

confidence.description: How sure you are, after checking the claims in the code.

reasoning.description: At most three sentences, citing file:line of the code you checked.
